questions.q: Who accompanied the Prophet SAW on foot to Taif?
How is the city of Taif described?
options: A cool high city full of fruit and roses
questions.explain: Taif was a resort of the people of Makkah.

questions.q: Who was the slave from Nineveh who embraced Islam in Rabi'ah's orchard?
questions.explain: Addas was astonished that the Prophet knew about Prophet Yunus, and embraced Islam.

questions.q: What astonished Addas so that he embraced Islam?
options: Hearing Bismillah and that he knew of Prophet Yunus
Seeing a miracle of a mountain
questions.explain: The name of Allah opened Addas's heart.

questions.q: What did Zaid do when stones were thrown at the Prophet SAW?
options: Shielded him with his hands and face
questions.explain: Zaid risked himself to protect the Prophet.

questions.q: Who embraced Islam after hearing the Prophet SAW pray at night?
questions.explain: Allah gave help after the trial, including jinn who believed.

questions.q: Who protected him on re-entering Makkah although not a Muslim?
questions.explain: Mut'im brought him into Makkah with his armed sons.

questions.q: The Prophet SAW went to the local leaders, asked permission and conveyed his message politely.
questions.explain: True. That is the etiquette of visiting.

questions.q: The Prophet SAW was sent as a mercy to all the worlds.
questions.explain: True. This is stated in Al-Anbiya 21:107.

questions.q: Put these events in the right order.

items.text: He takes refuge in an orchard

questions.explain: He set out for Taif, was stoned, took refuge in an orchard, Addas embraced Islam, and finally he was protected by Mut'im.

questions.q: Match each term with its meaning.

right.text: A guarantee of safety from a protector
A city in Iraq, home of Prophet Yunus

questions.explain: Taif is a cool high city, Nineveh was the city of Prophet Yunus, jinn are beings of another realm, and jiwar is a guarantee of safety.

questions.q: You have lost the two people you relied on most, but there is still work to do. What example does the Prophet SAW give?
options: Keep striving despite accusation and loss
questions.explain: The Prophet SAW kept striving though blamed and having lost his two pillars.
